key_insight: A unified parametric finite element framework delivers first- and second-order time integration for planar Willmore flow with provable modified energy dissipation while avoiding large coupled nonlinear solves.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports efficient simulation of planar curve relaxation governed by bending energy and length penalization while promoting good mesh distribution.
method: Reformulate the flow using a global auxiliary variable.
Combine Jacobian-weighted midpoint curvature and a compatible discrete tangent to obtain exact discrete chain rules.
Reduce each stage to two linear solves sharing one coefficient matrix and one scalar nonlinear solve.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments demonstrate the expected temporal accuracy, energy dissipation, good mesh quality and computational efficiency.
watch_item: Solvability guarantees require suitable assumptions, and scalar-solve existence and uniqueness are local near unity under computable sufficient conditions.
paper_title: A Unified Framework for First- and Second-Order Energy-Stable Parametric Finite Element Methods for Planar Willmore Flow
